verdict.rationale: Marlin's docs clearly describe a single research task running autonomously for up to ~8 hours without further human input once a topic is set (docs-9, docs-10, docs-16), which matches the 'runs in background autonomously' idea. However, this is a one-shot session, not a recurring/scheduled automation you configure and forget — there's no evidence of triggers, schedules, or multi-run automation management typical of 'set up automations.' Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automation setup, background job management UI, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runtime.
